description: Returns the JSON Schema (x402-review/2, draft-07) that content_json must satisfy for a review of a product in the given category, for submit_admin_approved_review, register_purchase_review and update_review_content. Call this before writing a review to discover what fields are required. The response names the category's kind: a review carries schema_version, standard_checks and open_review, plus a category_checks block whose "category" is that kind, required unless every call failed (delivered error or timeout); the schema returned contains only that block. standard_checks.response_fields and standard_checks.request_fields are required: an empty list when the response had no fields or the endpoint takes no inputs. A category with no kind (outside the category vocabulary) is reviewed with standard_checks and open_review only. Paid health-check and directory listings cannot be reviewed. No chain_id or authentication needed — schemas are global and static.

category.description: Product category slug (e.g. 'chain.rpc'), as GET /v1/product-categories lists them.

name: get_review_schema
